newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal railway invites bids to electrify network.
newsitem.headline: Portugal railway invites bids to electrify network.

text.p: State railway Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses (CP) has invited bids to electrify its network in the Alentejo and Algarve regions of southern Portugal, a spokeswoman said.

She confirmed a report in Publico newspaper that the electrification of 350 km (220 miles) of railway lines, including the link between Aguas de Moura and Tunes, should take until the year 2002 to complete.
She could not confirm the value of the contract, but Publico estimated it could cost between 15 and 20 billion escudos ($97-130 million).
